message.content:
When it comes to jazz singing, several artists stand out as some of the best and most influential. Here’s a quick rundown of a few who are often considered among the top:

| Artist | Notable Contributions |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | Known as the “First Lady of Song,” she had impeccable pitch, scat singing mastery, and a wide vocal range. |
| **Billie Holiday** | Her emotive phrasing and unique voice made her a legend in jazz ballads and standards. |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | Nicknamed “Sassy” or “The Divine One,” she combined a rich contralto voice with incredible improvisational skill. |
| **Nina Simone** | Though she crossed into soul and blues, her jazz roots and powerful vocal delivery earned her a place among the greats. |
| **Louis Armstrong** | While primarily a trumpeter, his gravelly voice and charismatic delivery helped shape early jazz vocals. |

These singers have left an indelible mark on jazz, each bringing their own style and emotional depth to the genre. If you’re looking to explore jazz vocals, starting with their recordings is a great way to experience the breadth and beauty of jazz singing.
